as_told.title: Havana syndrome attributed to Russian microwave weaponry

plain: Eric Haseltine, a former senior official at the National Security Agency, the US spy agency for electronic communications, talked with podcast host Jesse Michels about "Havana syndrome." That is the name for mysterious illnesses reported by US diplomats and intelligence officers at home and abroad. Haseltine points to an interview on 60 Minutes, a US television news programme, in which it was said that if the Russians are behind these attacks, which by this account go back to the 1980s, that would be an act of war.
